text: dsh-model-sync 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的模型供应商同步插件，在设置页提供 Model Sync 面板，并可在会话打开时自动运行。它通过 DSH 的模型发现接口查询已配置供应商的模型，再将发现结果替换保存的模型列表，同时保留供应商其他配置。用户可以手动同步全部供应商、查看新增和移除数量，并开启带防抖的自动同步；单个供应商查询失败时会保留其原有配置。适合需要让 DSH 中模型列表跟随供应商接口更新的用户。需要先在 DSH 配置供应商，无需插件专用密钥。

dsh-model-sync refreshes DSH provider model lists through discovery. Its web Settings panel supports manual and conversation-open sync. Discovered models replace the saved list while other provider settings remain; failed queries leave that provider unchanged. Configure providers in DSH first.
想让 DSH 自动更新每个模型供应商当前支持的模型。
能不能在设置页点一下就同步所有供应商的模型？
打开新会话时刷新模型列表，省得每次手动维护。
让 DSH 把供应商已经下架的模型从列表里清掉。
一个模型接口出错时，希望其他供应商仍然能完成同步。
我想同时保留供应商地址和密钥，只更新它的模型目录。
怎么查看同步后每家服务新增或移除了多少模型？
Keep my DSH provider model lists in sync with each provider's discovery endpoint.
Refresh model catalogs automatically when I open a conversation.
dsh-model-sync 的功能「手动同步模型」：在设置页打开 Model Sync 面板并点击 Sync All Models，插件逐个查询已配置供应商的模型目录，显示每家新增、移除和总数。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「会话打开时自动同步」：用户在设置面板打开自动同步开关后，每次会话启动事件触发模型发现并更新列表；两次自动同步至少间隔配置的防抖时间。
dsh-model-sync 的功能「替换模型目录并隔离失败」：同步成功时以接口发现的模型完整替换旧列表并保留其他供应商字段；某家查询失败时保留该家原设置并报告错误。
dsh-model-sync 使用发现到的模型列表整体替换已保存列表，因此供应商接口未返回的旧模型会被移除；其他供应商字段会保留。（见 src/index.ts:128-139）

@dsh-external/dsh-model-sync README · dsh-model-sync：[中文](./README.zh.md) | **English**

One-click / auto model sync for DeepSeek Harness providers. The plugin queries each provider's `/v1/models` endpoint and **replaces** the stored model list with what the endpoint advertises (models the endpoint no longer lists are removed; other provider fields are kept).

@dsh-external/dsh-model-sync README · Features：- **Manual sync** — one-click sync of every configured provider from the *Model Sync* panel in Settings. Sync runs in the browser through the official `settings` / `llm` APIs — no custom Host RPC.
- **Auto-sync** — re-syncs whenever a conversation page opens (Host listens on `agent/session-start`, 10s debounce). The toggle persists in the plugin's `model-sync` settings namespace + localStorage.
- **Replace semantics** — the discovered list IS the final list; provider models that were removed or added are reflected correctly.
- **Failure isolation** — a failing provider does not affect the others; failed providers keep their previous config.

@dsh-external/dsh-model-sync README · Configuration：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoSync` | boolean | `false` | Auto-sync model lists whenever a conversation page opens |
| `debounceMs` | number | `10000` | Minimum milliseconds between two automatic syncs |

The auto-sync switch can also be toggled in the Settings UI; changes are written to the `model-sync` namespace.

@dsh-external/dsh-model-sync README · How it works：```
Conversation page opens → agent/session-start event (Host)
  → re-query each provider's /v1/models
  → settings.update writes the new model list
  → settings/document-updated fires

Manual sync uses only official wire APIs (`llm.discoverModels` + `settings.mutate`) — no custom Host RPC.
